notes.title: Retro dungeon crawler Brany Skeldalu gets a Linux version and source code re-release
notes.notes:
Gates of Skeldal (Czech: Brány Skeldalu) originally released in 1998 and recently it gained a Native Linux version along with a source code re-release.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/05/retro-dungeon-crawler-brany-skeldalu-gets-a-linux-version-and-source-code-re-release/

notes.title: Source code released
notes.notes:
The Gates of Skeldal source code has now been released under the MIT license.

This isn't entirely new, as the source code was publicly available even before its Steam release, but we hope this formal release will help increase its reach.

https://github.com/ondra-novak/gates_of_skeldal

Now you can modify the game, improve it, help with bug fixes and testing, compile it on all sorts of weird hardware, and so on.

Please note that only the source code is released under the MIT license, not the graphics, game design, sound, or other assets, and definitely not the brand!
